hero.title: Nursing in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: **Nursing in Mauritius for Indian Students** can offer exposure to healthcare education in a multicultural environment, with training pathways ranging from assistant-nurse qualifications to professional nursing programmes. For international students, the key considerations are the institution’s recognition, admission eligibility, clinical placements, total costs and professional registration after graduation. Students exploring **Nursing in Mauritius for Indian Students** should carefully compare available programmes and their professional recognition before making a decision.

overview: The Nursing Council of Mauritius regulates the nursing and midwifery professions and publishes guidance on nursing schools, training and registration. Students should verify a programme through official sources before enrolling.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Nursing in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Nursing in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Nursing in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
